hook: Why pay full price for the same 80-page document on every query?
bullets: 14 queries resend a 40k-token filing as fresh input
The static filing moves first, marked cache_control
Query 1 writes the cache, queries 2 to 14 read it at about 10% of input price
Cost per case drops from $1.68 to $0.276, an 84% saving
cta: Watch the flow, then go deeper in the full course:
shows: This short animation shows prompt caching: a long filing is paid for once, not on every query.
